Subject: James G. Steinberg, - Criminal Record
for Visa Purposes.

Major F. W. Gerrard, C.I.E.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai, China.

Sir:

With reference to the correspondence between
this Consulate General and your office concerning
James G. Steinberg under date of April 18th and
April 26, 1932, I have the honor to request that
you be kind enough to furnish this office with a
certificate, in quadruplicate, indicating the exact
nature of the charges on which Mr. Steinberg was
convicted which resulted in his imprisonment. The
certificate need not contain any reference to the
evidence offered against him at his trial.

This information is required in order to place
at the disposal of the U. S. Department of Labor
evidence concerning Mr. Steinberg's admissibility
to the United States under the immigration laws,
which forbid the admission of persons convicted of
a felony or other crime involving moral turpitude.

I have the honor to be, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Edwin S. Cunningham
American Consul General.

F. W. 杰拉德 少校，C.I.E.勋衔，
警务处处长，
上海工部局，
中国上海。

先生：

关于本总领事馆与贵处于1932年4月18日和4月26日就詹姆斯·G·斯坦伯格一事进行的通信往来，谨此恳请贵处惠予提供一份证明书，一式四份，说明斯坦伯格先生被判刑并导致其入狱的确切指控性质。该证明书无需包含任何关于其审判期间针对他提出的证据的提及。

需要此信息是为了向美国劳工部提供有关斯坦伯格先生根据移民法获准进入美国的证据，该法律禁止被判处重罪或涉及道德败坏的其他罪行的人入境。

谨此致意，先生，
您顺从的仆人，

埃德温·S·坎宁安
美国总领事。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3554
25/4/32

April 25, 32.

Sir,

James George Steinberg.

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter of April 18, 1932, concerning the above,
and have to inform you that a person named Jack
George Steinberg, age 28 years, last known address
115 Rue Amiral Courbet, who was stated to be in
possession of American papers, although he was not
registered at the U.S. Consulate in Shanghai, was
arrested and charged with three counts of Fraud and
sentenced to 4 months imprisonment by the Shanghai
Special Area 1st District Court on 9-4-32. A
photograph of J.G. Steinberg is also attached for
your information.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(sgd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

E.S. Cunningham Esquire,
U.S. Consul-General,
Shanghai.

* Incl. 1.
25/4/32 S.D.

詹姆斯·乔治·斯坦伯格。

谨此确认收到您1932年4月18日关于上述人员的来信，并须通知您，一名名为杰克·乔治·斯坦伯格（Jack George Steinberg）、年龄28岁、最后已知住址为库尔贝海军上将路115号（115 Rue Amiral Courbet）的人，据称持有美国证件，尽管他未在美国驻上海领事馆注册，已被逮捕并被指控三项欺诈罪，于1932年4月9日被上海特区第一地方法院判处4个月监禁。现随函附上 J.G. 斯坦伯格的照片一张，供贵方参考。

上海。
